description: Manual CLI runs inside herdr/tmux spawn real split panes (HERDR_ENV/TMUX are inherited); herdr split --focus stole focus from the user.
resolution: Run manual sanity checks with env -u HERDR_ENV -u HERDR_PANE_ID (or -u TMUX); reference/viewer panes use focus:false (tmux -d, herdr without --focus).

title: Deterministic view ordering and ROOTS.md
rationale: ROOTS.md diffs must show only intent changes

title: view labels answered paragraphs with their question
rationale: Readers of idea.md/ROOTS.md could not tell what a paragraph answered. view splits each body via blame.answerBlocks and prefixes answered blocks with a quoted **Q:** line (id + asker, [agent] marked); question stays labeled, never mixed into prose. Older answers without hashes are placed by replaying the session's spans when the file hash equals that session.end hash.
